name: Ascendancy: The Axiom Story
description: A lavishly produced holographic epic commissioned directly by Axiom Consolidated to commemorate the corponation's fortieth year of Meridian 88 territorial sovereignty. The film presents Axiom's founding board as visionary architects who personally prevented the city's collapse during the 2164 Infrastructure Crisis, a historical claim that independent historians have called 'aggressively counterfactual.' Mandatory screening was enforced in all Axiom-controlled Tier 2 and Tier 3 residential blocks during its release quarter.
cultural_impact: Sparked a wave of counter-propaganda filmmaking across independent studios and is now studied as a textbook example of holographic immersion used for political control.
story_hooks: A production intern hid real archival footage of the 2164 Crisis inside the film's background crowd renders — visible only when the hologram is paused and examined at close range.
A runner is hired to steal the original production server containing the film's unedited script, which reportedly names names in connection with the Crisis.
Axiom is now legally requiring the film to be shown at all new-employee orientation sessions — and someone is sabotaging the projection rigs.
